mapper.select: SELECT trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_prices (symbol, trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume, is_adjusted) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{tradeDate}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{volume}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open = VALUES(open), high = VALUES(high), low = VALUES(low), close = VALUES(close), volume = VALUES(volume)
